unitemized.reason: Putting issues into the WARNING group (spec/design divergence, missing scenario coverage) is a judgment about what the issues mean. The group is not a template heading, so a deterministic rule cannot check it.

Putting issues into the SUGGESTION group (pattern inconsistencies, minor improvements) is a judgment about what the issues mean. The group is not a template heading, so a deterministic rule cannot check it.
